`success-background.json` is a scrubbed notification trace from Codex 0.160.1
and the credential-free local protocol fixture (2026-10-06). It retains thread
and turn state notifications across normal completion and a yielded terminal.
UUIDs/paths are anonymized and long instruction text omitted. Tests also build

method sequences from the v2 protocol shapes in the initiative research.
